vibe_rationale: Fifteen years of community-led women's skateboarding with free entry; a strong, welcoming core in a single scene.
fit_notes: Women's sport and recovery angle is strong, but the adult share is unconfirmed and the youth programme suggests an all-ages crowd. Seven partners, a partnership page and a named contact, with sponsorship pricing on request. A nonprofit host in California, so local activation would need a partner.
